rendered_linux_units.mcp_dev:
# Managed by binnacle (binnacle setup): mode=dev host=127.0.0.1 port=8000 jobs_owner=manager repo=/tmp/binnacle-os0-reference
[Unit]
Description=Binnacle FastMCP server (development: checkout with auto-reload)
After=network.target binnacle-jobs.service
Wants=binnacle-jobs.service

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/tmp/binnacle-os0-reference
ExecStart=/tmp/binnacle-os0-reference/.venv/bin/uvicorn binnacle.server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir /tmp/binnacle-os0-reference/src --loop uvloop --http httptools
# Hold the unit in "activating" until the port answers, so After= dependents
# (the tunnel) and `systemctl restart` callers see a server that is listening.
ExecStartPost=/bin/bash -c 'for i in $(seq 1 300); do (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8000) 2>/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; echo "binnacle: port 8000 not listening after 30 s" >&2; exit 1'
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
Environment=BINNACLE_MANAGED_DEPLOYMENT=1
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
